# Managed Flatpak apps: REMOTE APP HOST=STATE... all=STATE, one per line.
# Remotes are declared in flatpak.nix. HOST is `ws host`; STATE yes
# (installed there), no (declined), ask (not offered; wsflatpak apply asks).
# all= counts only for a workstation without its own mark (lib/ws_marks.py).
# `wsflatpak install|manage` mark this workstation yes (a new line gets
# all=ask), `wsflatpak remove` drops the line or marks it no when other
# workstations have marks, `unmanage` drops it; then `ws switch` (commits).
flathub com.github.tchx84.Flatseal mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub org.gimp.GIMP mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.mikrotik.WinBox mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.anydesk.Anydesk mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub us.zoom.Zoom mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.obsproject.Studio mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub org.videolan.VLC mbp16=yes all=ask
flatpark com.anthropic.ClaudeDesktop mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.mattjakeman.ExtensionManager mbp16=yes all=ask
# Launcher: desktop/com.valvesoftware.Steam.desktop (AMD when present).
# legiongo: native Steam (steam-installer), no flatpak.
flathub com.valvesoftware.Steam mbp16=yes legiongo=no all=ask
flathub com.jgraph.drawio.desktop mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub org.qbittorrent.qBittorrent mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.notesnook.Notesnook mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub org.onlyoffice.desktopeditors mbp16=yes all=ask
# Browser (snapd is purged, nix/hosts/apt.txt)
flathub org.mozilla.firefox mbp16=yes all=ask
chatgpt io.github.rulin132.ChatGPT mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub org.blender.Blender mbp16=yes all=ask
flathub com.github.PintaProject.Pinta mbp16=yes all=ask
